maria: Heads up — scheduled prod push at 21:30 UTC. I'm blocked: my MFA token got wiped when I replaced my phone. Can someone else run the deploy if I can't re-enroll before the window?
chris: Do you have the emergency-provisioner role? That one can push but needs a signed exception ticket.
maria: I don't. Security controls removed it when I rotated keys last month. @tina any quick options?
tina: We can create a short-lived exception (eng-release-exceptions). Policy is 2 approvers + audit entry, 1hr max. I'll pre-approve if SRE + eng lead ack.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: interactive deploy requires role 'deployer' or an approved exception ticket. To create exception use: /ticket create EXCEPTION template=eng-deploy-exception approvers=@tina,@oncall-sre
oncall-sre: If we open one, pin the image and enable canary/automatic rollback gating. Also ensure the audit log includes the exception ID.
alex: Can maria hand off to chris? Chris — do you have deployer on your laptop and are you able to run from VPN?
chris: I have deployer but only on my work laptop behind corp VPN. I'm remote but can join the window and run the deploy.
maria: OK I'll create the exception ticket now and add @tina + @chris as approvers. I'll include the release note blurb.
maria: release notes: "hotfix: revert cache serialization change; rollout plan: 50% canary -> 100% at +15m if metrics green"
tina: Also: pin to v2.3.7-hotfix, do NOT deploy main. Command for deploy: `/deploy prod --image=v2.3.7-hotfix --canary=50 --notes "rollback-safe"`
chris: Copy that. I'll run the canary and watch metrics. If anything spikes we rollback to v2.3.6.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by chris at 2009991255. Canary at 50%. Canary metrics: latency +1.2ms, error-rate 0.0%.
maria: Confirming: exception PRJ-4567 approved by tina + chris, recorded in audit.
oncall-sre: Logged: PRJ-4567, requestor=maria, approvers=[tina,chris], expires=2009994890. Reminder: rotate emergency token within 24h.
maria: Thanks everyone. Action item: add quick MFA replace flow to 'deployer oncall' runbook to avoid handoffs next time.
alex: Noted — adding runbook item now. :thumbsup:
